top_issues: The 'Two colours, one rule' explainer card still occupies prime first-scroll space on home; once read it is noise and pushes balances and actions down
Balance composition legend relies on colour swatches (green/violet squares) with no shape differentiation; colour-blind users lose the secured-vs-promised distinction
'Show 1 empty' and 'Add money'/'Move' sit on the same line as the BALANCES label at small sizes; tap targets ~30px are below the 44px comfortable minimum
Total balance bar (green+violet) has no axis or tick; the 'one scale' rule is asserted in text but not visible on home itself
fixes: Dismiss the explainer permanently after 'Got it' and replace with a one-line hint until first dispute or first credit change
Add a pattern (solid vs hatched) to violet 'promised' segments so meaning survives without colour
Raise BALANCES row action tap targets to 44px and move 'Add money' into the primary action row

top_issues: H1 account card: '+115.00 owes you' is the biggest number, but the bar's green/violet split and the tiny in-flight tick after the bar are unexplained on this screen
'Swap closed / closed' row has no amount; the user cannot tell what value the closed swap settled without tapping through
'All activity' link is bottom-left and low contrast; the natural thumb action is missing a full-width affordance
Two progress-bar languages on one screen: account card bar (green/violet/room) and activity rows' small status bars (green/violet) with no legend
fixes: Show the settled amounts inline on swap rows (e.g. '18.58 USDC → 0.0074 WETH · closed')
Add a one-tap info affordance on the account bar that opens the same colour legend as home
Make 'All activity' a full-width row with chevron

top_issues: Address shown in full wraps to two lines in mono grey; no copy button and no resolved-name confirmation beyond '✓ H2' — Rosa cannot verify who she pays
'receive up to 0.50' is the hub's inbound room, but nothing tells the user this number limits what H2 can send back; jargon risk
Fee 'under 0.01 USDC' is vague next to route 2 showing exact 0.000050; the primary route should show the exact fee too
'1 OTHER ROUTE' collapsed disclosure is easy to miss; users cannot compare fees without expanding
fixes: Show a human-readable recipient line (name, avatar, truncated address with copy) above the raw address
Replace 'under 0.01' with the exact fee and keep '≈' only for pre-quote states
Auto-expand other routes when the fee delta exceeds 20%

top_issues: Route comparison cards repeat the same route chip row as the summary 'Route' row directly above — duplicated information costs a full screen of scroll
The bar under 'Your account with H1' now shows a credit-room segment but the amount row says 120.00 while 'send up to 180.00' — three numbers for capacity without an explicit tie
Amount keyboard: no quick 'Max' or percentage chips; typing 180 by hand is error-prone
'You send 25.00' on both route cards is identical, so the only differentiator is fee rendered in small grey text
fixes: Collapse the summary Route row when the route picker is expanded
Label capacity explicitly: 'room 120 = balance 25 + credit 155' or link to the account bar
Add Max / 50% / 25% chips next to the amount field and render the fee delta bold on route cards

top_issues: 'Settled 05:24:03 · in 9 s' mixes absolute and relative time without a unit label for 'in' (looks like countdown vs duration)
Proof hash truncated '0x00109fe5…6bec' with no tap-to-copy or view-full; Elena-style audit needs the full value
Four equal-width action buttons (Copy receipt / Download / Print / PDF / Done) give Done no visual priority until colour, and Copy/Download overlap in meaning
Background home card is visible but dimmed to near-illegibility; the H1 balance behind no longer matches the pre-payment numbers, which may confuse on close
fixes: Label the duration explicitly: 'settled in 9 s at 05:24:03'
Make the proof row tappable: copy on tap, long-press or chevron for full hash and signature
Merge Copy/Download into one 'Share receipt' and give Done the full-width primary slot

overall.verdict: A coherent, premium dark wallet whose colour discipline (green = yours, violet = promised) and receipt/proof surfaces are genuinely ahead of most shipping wallets. It is held back by jargon density (rooms, lanes, capacity, collateral tariffs) and small dense tap targets that will lose Rosa and Lucas even as Wei and Ingrid approve.
priority_fixes: Add a persistent, tap-anywhere colour/bar legend so green-vs-violet and the one-scale rule are decodable without reading paragraphs
Replace jargon labels (capacity, room, lanes, inbound room) with plain sentences plus the number on Pay, Receive and account screens
Give human-readable recipients (names/avatars, truncated address, copy) on Pay instead of raw wrapped hashes
Raise all small action tap targets (BALANCES row, route chips, receipt buttons) to 44px and make primary actions full-width
Show exact fees everywhere and auto-surface route alternatives when the fee difference is material

personas.name: Rosa

blockers: Colour-only meaning on home balance squares
Explainer card requires reading a full paragraph to feel safe
'receive up to 0.50' and 'owes you' on home are unexplained jargon

personas.name: Jamal
personas.verdict: Payments landing with 'settled' badges and a spendable-now number is exactly what I want at a red light.
blockers: No filter or badge on home for incoming-only activity
Swap 'open' row shows no amount until tapped

personas.name: Priya

blockers: No settlement summary or end-of-day view among the screens
Payment request flow (request with fixed amount as primary) is not shown as a first-class action

Book was provided only as a partial screenshot
